claims.claim: Monitoring interval and response latency add to the blind stewardship window.
Blind-window loss decomposes into monitoring-delay loss plus response-delay loss.
Compared with zero response delay, latency consumes exactly rate times latency additional reserve.
Nonnegative residual reserve is equivalent to blind-window loss not exceeding reserve.
For nonnegative deterioration rate, increasing response delay cannot reduce blind-window loss.
A cycle is non-increasing when active repair capacity covers passive deterioration.
The boundary-safe and excessive-latency examples are exact nonvacuity witnesses.
The exact-rational package replay is green.
Rates, delays, compatible units, linear deterioration, and constant repair are supplied model assumptions.
A real ecological trigger, calibrated intervention, field outcome, thermodynamic dissipation, adoption, delivery, or revenue is established.
